description: Header file defining the ClientInfo class for crash client process management in Google Breakpad's Windows crash generation module.

classes.name: ClientInfo
classes.description: Represents a crash client process, managing crash data collection, synchronization handles, and process info.

methods.name: ClientInfo
methods.description: Constructor initializing the client info with process details and crash server reference.

methods.name: crash_server
methods.description: Returns the associated crash generation server.

methods.name: ex_info
methods.description: Returns pointer to exception info in client process.

methods.name: assert_info
methods.description: Returns assertion info from client process.

methods.name: GetClientExceptionInfo
methods.description: Fetches exception info from client process.

methods.name: GetClientThreadId
methods.description: Fetches thread ID from client process.

methods.name: PopulateCustomInfo
methods.description: Reads custom info from client process memory.

methods.name: UnregisterDumpRequestWaitAndBlockUntilNoPending
methods.description: Unregisters dump request wait handle and waits for pending callbacks.

methods.name: UnregisterProcessExitWait
methods.description: Unregisters process exit wait handle, optionally waiting for callbacks.
